name: Remniants
desc:
this game is cool but unpolished, do not take this game seriously but we would enjoy your dedication to this game and help us out by supporting !!

Join our group: Forsaken but more Community to get a 25% money boost!
[ALPHA, EXPECT EVERYTHING TO CHANGE AS IN HITBOXES,  GAMEPLAY, ETC.]


Step into a twisted realm where survival is a privilege, not a promise.
Choose from 13 unique survivors, each with their own abilities, stories, and strategies available through in-game progression or purchase. Work together or alone to outlast the opposition.

Standing in your way are 4 powerful killers. Each killer has a distinct style, from brutal and relentless to deceptive and psychological.


You only get one life per round.
No respawns. No second chances.
Use your skills, your allies, and your instincts to survive... or perish trying.

Every match is different.
Every choice could be your last.
Will you escape… or become a Remniant?

Formerly known as Forsaken but more
